  Scenario: AC14 An activity is retried and times out
    Given the extract activity of DocumentIntakeWorkflow on queue rwb-document
    When the activity fails with a transient error
    Then the activity is retried under the retry policy of the workflow
    When the activity does not complete within its timeout
    Then the extraction status is FAILED

  Scenario: AC15 A consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given the rwb-case contract mock is set to fail the call
    When extraction runs
    Then the extraction status is FAILED
    Then no document_field row is written

  Scenario: AC16 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given a document with extraction status PENDING
    When a status change that the model does not allow is requested
    Then the change is refused
    Then the extraction status stays PENDING
